Ada — RL/Electric charge-attacker. Board: 0.924 COLD on 2 graded comps (0.92 / 0.93). Kit-faithfulness is certified by the unit spec, INCLUDING the Special Modification shot count: the swap carries maxShots 1, the kit's literal 'for 1 round(s)', owner-confirmed 2026-08-11 (one special-charged shot per window). She previously read 0.995 because the swap was uncapped and fired a second special shot per window; the board was leaning on damage the kit does not grant, so this is faithful > fit and the COLD reading is the honest one. Do NOT close it by uncapping the swap or shaving another value — her residual is now a magnitude question, unconfounded by the shot count.
S1 (fullBurstEnter): buffs the Burst-3 allies who ALREADY burst this rotation — kit-literal 'all Burst 3 allies who previously used their Burst Skill', encoded as target burstCasters stage 3. The stage filter is load-bearing: an unfiltered burstCasters target would feed her +60%-of-caster ATK grant to every burst caster including B1/B2 supports. Grants casterAtkPct 60 + trueDamagePct 50, 10s, plus the lifesteal's recovery-event WINDOW as an event-only heal (ticks 10, intervalSec 1) on the same block, refreshing bursted-B3 on-recovery consumers (asuka S1) once a second across the window. The HP amount has no engine consumer — there is no HP pool — so only the event is modeled.
S2 Flash Grenade Toss: a 420% True-Damage dot every 2s for 10s on EVERY Full-Burst enter, plus a SECOND identical every-2s stream on her own burstCast — that second stream is the kit's burst rider ('Flash Grenade Toss activation time condition ▼1 sec for 10 sec'), so during her own burst windows the two streams together deliver the kit's doubled rate — 10 tosses per 10s window, damage-identical to the kit's 1/s (the engine's first-tick semantics land them as pairs ~0.37s apart every 2s rather than evenly spaced). True-flavored, so her S1 and burst True Damage ▲ buffs apply to the grenades only (the engine gates trueDamagePct by flavor).
BURST: self atkPct 40 + trueDamagePct 42 (10s), and Special Modification as a weaponSwap — damagePct 61.3, chargeTimeSec 4 (the kit's Charge Speed ▼300%), chargeMultPct 1750 (base 250 + the kit's Charge Damage ▲1500), 10s.
SWAP CADENCE: her swap sets no `weapon` and she carries no measured unit-level pullsPerSec, so the 'a swap shadows a unit's measured cadence' engine gap does not reach her; her window is charge-time-gated in any case.

skill1: Recovers 10% of the damage dealt as HP for 10 sec. — magnitude only: the 10s recovery-event WINDOW is modeled (event-only heal ticks:10 intervalSec:1 on the fullBurstEnter→burstCasters block, firing bursted-B3 on-recovery consumers such as asuka S1); the HP amount has no engine consumer (no HP pool)

caveats: burst: Special Modification is capped at maxShots 1 on the weaponSwap — the kit's literal 'for 1 round(s)', owner-confirmed 2026-08-11 (one special-charged shot per window). Pinned by the EXACTLY-one case in scripts/tests/units/ada.test.ts.
